title: THE FINALS
description: A free-to-play team-based first-person shooter presented as a virtual combat game show, with destructible arenas, distinct contestant builds and objective-driven matches.

player_sentiment.summary: Sampled PC user reviews praise destruction, movement and creative team tactics, while some criticize balancing, matchmaking and server problems; the sample spans updates and does not establish present service quality.
negatives: Frustrating matchmaking and solo play for some
